title: The Teal Titan of Gold's on 5th
creativeBrief: Marcus takes three dry scoops of an experimental pre-workout. His skin turns vivid teal and his physique escalates continuously into a monumental, balanced bodybuilder form. The gym responds with understated reverence. He never stops posing.

continuityLocks.anatomy: rounded connected muscle groups; continuous deltoid-pectoral-arm and torso transitions

continuityLocks.surface: living skin, subtle tonal variation, soft natural highlights; no stone, rubber, metallic gloss or gritty overlays
